description: Scan source code (or snippet) for hardcoded secrets — cloud provider keys, API tokens, connection strings, private keys, passwords. Supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, Shell, Bash. Use to detect leaked credentials before commit; for injection detection use check_injection. Free: 30/hr, Pro: 500/hr. Returns {total, by_severity, findings}. No data stored. The generic password-assignment rule is suppressed when a more-specific credential rule fires on the same line — one targeted finding per leaked secret, not two.

code.description: Source code string to scan for secrets (can be a single file or code snippet)
code.title: Code

language.description: Programming language of the code. Must be one of: python, javascript, typescript, java, go, ruby, shell, bash, generic. Use 'generic' if unsure.
language.title: Language
